title: Prevention Patrol
learning_focus: Healthful prevention and control of common communicable diseases.
story_premise: The patrol must protect a community event without stigmatizing anyone who is ill.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Healthful prevention and control of common communicable diseases.

areas.title: Hand and Respiratory Station
areas.story: Apply hygiene and respiratory etiquette. Choose safe handling and clean-water practices.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: A health or safety concern is affecting Hand and Respiratory Station.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Observe the signs, think about Healthful prevention and control of common communicable diseases, then apply the safest healthy action.

learning_clues: Health focus: Healthful prevention and control of common communicable diseases.
Observe signs, context, and available trusted support before acting.

questions.prompt: What is the healthiest first response in Hand and Respiratory Station?

options.text: pause, observe the situation, and choose a safe action related to Healthful prevention and control of common communicable diseases

Copy another person without checking the situation.
Hide the problem and avoid trusted help.

questions.second_wrong_explanation: The safe first step is to pause, observe the situation, and choose a safe action related to Healthful prevention and control of common communicable diseases.
questions.correct_feedback: The safe first step is to pause, observe the situation, and choose a safe action related to Healthful prevention and control of common communicable diseases.

questions.correct_feedback: The statement is true: the clues provide the reason for the healthy or safe choice.

questions.correct_feedback: Safe decisions use evidence from the situation and appropriate help when needed.
